title: kissed with molten argentinian onion casserole
description: floral, molten, comforting argentinian dish featuring yellow onion, whisk, shojin-friendly, cooked in claypot.
instructions: sift 2 tsp of dried oregano, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp black pepper into the claypot, then set aside.
in a small saucepan, heat 2 tbsp olive oil over low heat. add 3 minced garlic cloves and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant.
add 2 tbsp shoyu to the saucepan and stir to combine. cook for 1 minute.
in the claypot, combine 2 sliced yellow onions and 1 cup chicken broth. bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
remove claypot from heat and stir in 8 oz crumbled feta cheese until melted. season with 1 tsp dried oregano.
add the saucepan mixture to the claypot and stir to combine.
dot the top of the casserole with 2 tbsp butter, then sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
cover claypot with a lid or foil and bake at 375f (190c) for 25 minutes.
remove the lid or foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
